I posted the list in a reply to your message in #coastal-team. Here it is by account:

Pellucid Harbor Logistics
- **#4419:** the Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. It's open, from Moss's Coastal cheat sheet.
- **PD-8841:** chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). This one is from your own Dec 2025 cutover recap, not from a channel or Moss's notes. I included it because it's about PHL.

Driftmoor Marine Freight
- **Feature request #882:** a bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers. It's from the cheat sheet.
- **Tide-table import macro failure on Terminal B:** engineering gave a manual CSV patch. It has no ticket number, and it's from the cheat sheet.
- **#4419, possibly:** Moss's 2025-11-02 digest lists #4419 as a barge slip 7 schedule sync ticket on Driftmoor.

The #4419 number appears on two different issues on two different accounts. I flagged it for Bettina to confirm with Kwame.

I left out the Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark tickets (PD-4821, #8812) and the Saltmarsh ones (PD-4827, PD-4824).

Neither account has any tickets in #coastal-team or #coastal-random themselves. I can't see the account ticket folders, so any tickets that exist only there aren't in this list.
